description: This file contains the implementation of the dBug class, a PHP debugging utility that visually displays variable contents in a colored, tabular format similar to ColdFusion's cfdump. It includes methods for handling different variable types (arrays, objects, resources, XML), rendering HTML with embedded JavaScript and CSS for toggling visibility of nested structures, and utility functions for type checking and introspection.

classes.name: dBug
classes.description: A PHP class that provides an enhanced var_dump-style debugging output with colored, interactive HTML tables for variables.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the dBug object and processes the variable for dumping, with optional forceType and collapse settings.

methods.name: getVariableName
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the variable name from the code using debug_backtrace and regex parsing.

methods.name: makeTableHeader
methods.description: Creates the HTML table header for a variable type, optionally with collapsible style.

methods.name: makeTDHeader
methods.description: Creates a table row header within the dump output, with click-to-toggle functionality.

methods.name: closeTDRow
methods.description: Closes a table cell row.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Generates an error message string for unsupported variable types.

methods.name: checkType
methods.description: Checks the type of a variable and calls the appropriate handler.

methods.name: varIsNULL
methods.description: Outputs the 'NULL' label.

methods.name: varIsBoolean
methods.description: Outputs 'TRUE' or 'FALSE' based on boolean value.

methods.name: varIsArray
methods.description: Handles array variables, recurses into elements, and manages circular references.

methods.name: varIsObject
methods.description: Handles object variables, displays properties and methods, manages recursion and circular references.

methods.name: varIsResource
methods.description: Handles resource variables and dispatches to specific handlers based on resource type.

methods.name: varIsDBResource
methods.description: Handles database resource variables, displaying result sets.

methods.name: varIsGDResource
methods.description: Handles GD image resources, displaying width, height, and color count.

methods.name: varIsXml
methods.description: Handles XML string or resource variables.

methods.name: varIsXmlResource
methods.description: Parses and displays XML resources, constructing a nested view.

methods.name: xmlParse
methods.description: Helper for parsing XML data with libxml.

methods.name: xmlStartElement
methods.description: Callback when an XML start tag is encountered; builds data structures for display.

methods.name: xmlEndElement
methods.description: Callback when an XML end tag is encountered; outputs accumulated data.

methods.name: xmlCharacterData
methods.description: Handles character data between XML tags.

methods.name: xmlDefaultHandler
methods.description: Handles miscellaneous XML data such as comments.

methods.name: initJSandCSS
methods.description: Outputs embedded JavaScript and CSS for toggling the expandable/collapsible views.
